# `sleepThenEffectToDelay`

Suggests Effect.delay instead of sequencing an effect after Effect.sleep

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377178` |
| Language Service name | `sleepThenEffectToDelay` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/sleep-then-effect-to-delay` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const sendRequest: Effect.Effect<void>

export const throttled = Effect.sleep("1 second").pipe(Effect.andThen(sendRequest))
/**
                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(sleep-then-effect-to-delay): `Effect.sleep` sequenced before this effect re-implements `Effect.delay`. `Effect.delay` expresses the postponed effect directly.
*/
```
